sources.name: Search Engine Roundtable
sources.excerpt: Google Search Ranking Volatility Gets Heated October 24th. This past Saturday, October 24th, we saw some significant ranking volatility captured by many of the third-party Google tracking tools. There was also some heavy chatter within the SEO industry about ranking movement and Google traffic changes over the past couple of days. The two together make me believe that there was some Google Search ranking adjustment released Friday and into Saturday.
